plainText:
Eileen Frances Stevens (born January 7, 1982) is a voice actress for the English-language dub of . She is currently affiliated with Stewart Talent Agency.

==Biography==
Stevens joined the cast of the during the eleventh season of . Her first role on the show was Spring in the episode Tanks for the Memories!. In the , she acquired one of her most significant roles yet, providing the voice of . Her other notable roles in Black & White include (in the Zoroark: Master of Illusions), Jupiter, , and Elesa. In the , her notable roles are Serena's Fennekin and Braixen, as well as . Stevens left the animated series after the episode Acting True to Form!, with her roles being passed on to other actors. Stevens would later return to voice Iris in the episode Thrash of the Titans!, before leaving the show again, with her role of Iris being recast.
